title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Training Note — Days Counted for the Late Payment Charge of Long-Standing ProBuild Members
content:
**What are the days counted for the late charge?** On a Ridgeline Pro Credit commercial account, the days counted for the late payment charge of a closed statement start from the statement's days past due and, for a long-standing Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards member, are reduced by all or half of the tier's late charge grace days.

**Which rule applies?**

| The business's active Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership | Days counted for the late charge |
|---|---|
| Enrolled at least 60 whole months and carrying a dedicated pro account representative | The statement's days past due less the tier's late charge grace days |
| Enrolled at least 60 whole months and carrying no dedicated representative | The statement's days past due less half the tier's late charge grace days, the half rounded down to a whole day |
| Any other case (enrolled less than 60 whole months, or no active membership) | The statement's days past due |

The days counted are never below zero.

**How is enrollment age counted?** In whole calendar months from the membership's enrollment date to the date the charge is assessed.

**Which memberships carry a dedicated pro account representative?** Under Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards the dedicated pro account representative is a benefit of the ProBuild Gold, ProBuild Platinum and ProBuild Platinum Elite tiers; the ProBuild Member, Bronze and Silver tiers carry none.

**What grace days apply?** Those of the account's tier: Commercial Account Net 30, 0; Net 30 Select, 5; Net 45, 5; Net 60 Enterprise, 10 (and 0 on the two revolving tiers).

**Worked cases (hypothetical, statement showing 14 days past due on a Commercial Account Net 60 Enterprise)**

- ProBuild Platinum, enrolled 72 whole months: 14 less 10, so 4 days counted.
- ProBuild Silver, enrolled 61 whole months: half of 10 is 5, so 14 less 5, 9 days counted.
- ProBuild Gold, enrolled 30 whole months: 14 days counted.
- On a Net 45 with 5 grace days and ProBuild Silver enrolled 60 whole months: half of 5 rounded down is 2, so 14 less 2, 12 days counted.
